# datadog_metric_tag_configuration_v2 (Resource)

Manages a metric's tag configuration independently of percentile aggregations. Creating, updating, or deleting this resource does not configure percentiles. Do not manage the same tag configuration with this resource and datadog_metric_tag_configuration simultaneously. Historical Metrics Ingestion is incompatible with a tag configuration. See the [migration guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/DataDog/datadog/latest/docs/guides/metric_tag_configuration_v2_migration) before migrating an existing resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The metric must already exist. This resource manages tags only;
# it does not enable or disable distribution percentiles.
resource "datadog_metric_tag_configuration_v2" "example" {
  metric_name = "app.request.duration"
  metric_type = "distribution"
  tags        = ["env", "service"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric_name` (String) The name of an existing metric. Also used as the resource ID and import identifier. Changing the name replaces the resource. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, dots, and underscores.
- `metric_type` (String) The metric type: count, gauge, rate, or distribution. Changing the type replaces the resource. Valid values are `count`, `gauge`, `rate`, `distribution`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag keys that remain queryable. An empty set keeps no tags when exclude_tags_mode is false. This resource does not modify the metric's percentile setting.

### Optional

- `exclude_tags_mode` (Boolean) When true, tags lists the keys to exclude rather than include. Requires at least one tag. Defaults to false. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by metric name. Import does not create a tag configuration or change percentiles.
terraform import datadog_metric_tag_configuration_v2.example app.request.duration
```
